description.value:
The Academy's basic Substitution Technique — less polished than the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-actions.Item.ClAcSubstition00]{full version} but always available.

Trigger a creature within 30 feet of you targets you with a Strike, and the result has not been revealed.

You swap places with an unattended Small or Medium object within 5 feet of you. The triggering Strike resolves against the substitute (treat it as your AC with 1 HP). You may move up to 5 feet to an unoccupied square as part of the substitution. You can use this cantrip only once per encounter; refreshing it requires a 10-minute rest.

Heightened (3rd) The range you can move increases to 10 feet, and you can use it twice per encounter.

system.requirements: you can see the triggering creature
